bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/ (built-in instruments and effects), springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (audio service)
summary: Apple's Audio Unit framework hosts third-party AU v2 and v3 plug-ins and provides the AUAudioUnit subclassing API for plug-in extensions. BifrOSt has a plug-in host model and an extension point model (manifests, a registry and render-resource allocation), and since 2026-10-19 an in-process loader for third-party units over its own C ABI (springboard/audio/units/src/plugin.rs), a sample-accurate sequencer unit and a General MIDI synth, but no AU binary compatibility and no separate extension process. The DAW ships its own built-in instruments and effects as JavaScript plug-in directories, which are not Audio Units. The Apple page itself marks the framework as deprecated in favour of Audio Toolbox.

features.feature: Hosting third-party AU v2 and v3 plug-ins
features.apple: AUAudioUnit, AudioUnit instantiation (Audio Unit framework landing page)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/plugin_host.rs (Instance, Instance::new, PluginVersion); springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-43.rs; springboard/audio/units/src/plugin.rs (PluginLibrary::open, PluginUnit, scan_directory); springboard/audio/units/examples/gain_plugin.c; springboard/cmd/src/unitctl.rs (bifrost-unit scan)
features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (written without a build, tests unrun): an in-process plug-in loader. A shared library exports bifrost_unit_entry, which returns a C ABI table (UnitVTable, version 1); PluginLibrary::open dlopens it, reads the component description and parameters, and instantiate() gives a PluginUnit that is an ordinary AudioUnit (it goes in a UnitHost, an engine node or the out-of-process Worker). The host owns the parameter ramps (the plug-in gets param_start and param_end each block), MIDI arrives at frame offsets, render allocates nothing, and non-finite output is silenced. register_into adds the plug-in to the ComponentRegistry and scan_directory loads /usr/lib/bifrost/units and ~/.local/share/bifrost/units. Unit tests use in-process tables and a real dlopen of libm. The ABI is ours (no AU v2 or v3 binary compatibility) and no separate extension process is started; the DAW rack does not load plug-ins yet. Midget check: build the C example on Titan (same x86_64): `cc -shared -fPIC -O2 -o cgain.so springboard/audio/units/examples/gain_plugin.c`, copy cgain.so to Midget, run `bifrost-unit scan .` (expect `C Gain  effect  aufx/cgan/test  up to 2 channels  1 parameter` and a line for parameter 0 Main/Gain), then `bifrost-unit render ./cgain.so /tmp/g.wav` (peak 0.500) and `bifrost-unit render ./cgain.so --set 0=2 /tmp/g2.wav` (peak 1.000).

features.apple: AUAudioUnit subclassing for app extensions (landing page: Version 3 extensions)
features.note: built on parity/team-j-audio-unit; not yet verified on Midget. Pure model: the host supplies the render unit factory, allocates bus formats and render resources, and renders through the session. No extension process is started.

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/fx.rs (17 effects), springboard/apps/daw/src/dsp.rs (biquad, compressor, delay, LFO, oscillator)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. DAW-only, not exposed to other apps as an audio unit; effect routing is fixed in the DAW

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/inst/, springboard/apps/daw/assets/plugins/celesta/index.js (sampled instruments via host.multisample); springboard/audio/units/src/synth.rs (GmSynth); springboard/audio/units/src/sequencer.rs (SequencerUnit)
features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (tests unrun): GmSynth, a 32-voice polyphonic General MIDI instrument that needs no sound bank (additive tone by program, drums on channel 10, volume, pan, expression, sustain pedal, pitch bend, all notes off), registered as aumu/gmsy/bfst, and SequencerUnit, which plays timed messages through any instrument sample-accurately. The DAW keeps its JavaScript instruments and the sampled ones (host.multisample); GmSynth is additive, not sampled. Midget check: `bifrost-unit render gm --note 69 /tmp/gm.wav` prints `2 channels, 96000 frames at 48000 Hz`, and `aplay /tmp/gm.wav` plays a 440 Hz tone that releases before the end; `bifrost-unit midi song.mid /tmp/song.wav` then `aplay /tmp/song.wav` plays a MIDI file.

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/mod.rs, springboard/apps/daw/src/store.rs (plugin ids and params); wired: springboard/apps/daw/src/rack.rs, springboard/apps/daw/src/params.rs (tree_from_extra, write_back), springboard/apps/daw/src/main.rs (draw_rack, rack_slide, rack_save_preset, rack_load_preset); tests: springboard/apps/daw/tests/parity_wire.rs; springboard/audio/units/src/plugin.rs; springboard/audio/units/src/preset.rs (export_user, import_user); springboard/sdk/src/audio_unit_view.rs (UnitView)
features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (tests unrun): a loaded plug-in declares its parameters in its table and they live in the host ParameterTree, so ramps, clamping, read-only flags and presets behave as for built-in units; PresetStore::export_user and import_user keep user presets in a text file; UnitView turns a ParamHandle into rows (log-taper slider, switch, pop-up, read-out) with value text, groups, drag, nudge, reset and preset selection. The DAW rack still uses its own parameter tree and hosts no external processors. Midget check: `bifrost-unit render gain /tmp/a.wav` prints peak 0.500 and `bifrost-unit render gain --set 0=2 /tmp/b.wav` prints peak 1.000 (the parameter set on the command line reaches the unit through its handle); `bifrost-unit scan <dir>` lists a plug-in's parameters with ranges and defaults.

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/playback.rs (Player renders to a cache), springboard/apps/daw/src/conv.rs (convolver); springboard/sdk/src/midi_player.rs (MidiPlayer::render, render_to_wav); springboard/audio/engine/src/engine.rs (Engine::render_offline); springboard/cmd/src/unitctl.rs (bifrost-unit render)
features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (tests unrun): the audio engine renders any graph offline and deterministically, and the SDK exposes it with the unit model (bifrost_app::audio_engine and its units module); MidiPlayer::render and render_to_wav render sequenced MIDI with a WAV writer, and bifrost-unit renders a unit or a MIDI file from a shell. The DAW still renders inside the app (playback.rs, conv.rs). Midget check: `bifrost-unit render sine /tmp/s.wav` prints `/tmp/s.wav: 2 channels, 96000 frames at 48000 Hz, peak ...` and the file plays with `aplay /tmp/s.wav`.

features.apple: Audio Unit host and Core Audio I/O (not a separate Apple feature row)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/system_audio.rs (Command, AudioClient); springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (audio service owns speaker and microphone), springboard/src/media/speaker.rs (ALSA output through dl.rs); springboard/proto/src/svc.rs (Cmd::SetPan, Cmd::FadeVolume, Cmd::SetRoute, Evt::Route); springboard/src/media/player_fx.rs; springboard/cmd/src/audioctl.rs (bifrost-audio)
features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (tests unrun): audiod applies stereo pan and timed volume fades (new commands SetPan and FadeVolume; Command::pan and Command::fade_volume in the SDK; the gain is ramped across each block and the state volume follows the fade) and reports the output route (the shell sends Cmd::SetRoute, subscribers get Evt::Route). bifrost-audio is a command-line client of the service. The earlier SDK client checks (volume, seek, queue, recording path) are unchanged. No app uses system_audio.rs yet and the round trip has not run on Midget. Midget check: with a song playing in Music run `bifrost-audio status`, `bifrost-audio pan -1` (sound only from the left speaker), `bifrost-audio pan 0`, `bifrost-audio fade 0 3000` (the volume falls to 0 over 3 s; `bifrost-audio status` shows it falling) and `bifrost-audio volume 0.6`.

features.apple: MIDI events delivered to instrument units
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/midi_events.rs; springboard/sdk/src/midi.rs (hub, events, ump); wired: springboard/apps/daw/src/midi_file.rs, springboard/apps/daw/src/midi.rs; tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-17.rs, springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-17.rs; springboard/sdk/src/midi_client.rs (MidiClient); springboard/audio/midid/src/server.rs; springboard/audio/midi/src/broker.rs; springboard/audio/midi/src/wire.rs; springboard/cmd/src/midictl.rs (bifrost-midi)
features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (tests unrun): devices are reachable from apps. bifrost-midid serves a unix socket (bifrost_midi::wire frames over bifrost_midi::broker) with rawmidi input, new rawmidi output and hotplug notifications; MidiClient lists devices, sources and destinations, connects sources, receives timestamped UMP packets in order, sends packets or MIDI 1.0 bytes, and SysexCollector joins system exclusive. The DAW still uses its own midi.rs and midi_file.rs; the MIDI 1.0 parser, encoder and sustain tracker stay as before. Midget check: attach a USB MIDI keyboard, `systemctl status bifrost-midid` (active), `bifrost-midi list` (the keyboard with a source id), `bifrost-midi monitor 20` and press keys: lines `NS name 2090XXYY` with growing stamps, note-off 2080....

gaps: Plug-ins load in-process through our own C ABI (springboard/audio/units/src/plugin.rs); there is no AU v2 or v3 binary compatibility and no extension process, and the DAW rack does not load them yet.
The unit and render API is bifrost_app::audio_engine (Engine and its units module); the DAW still renders and runs its devices internally.
MIDI input for apps is bifrost_app::midi_client; the DAW still uses its own MIDI path.
The audio service (springboard/audiod) has an SDK client (springboard/sdk/src/system_audio.rs) and a command-line client (bifrost-audio), but no app uses the SDK client yet.
